text: What comes next: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, ___?
why: The compass points go clockwise, so after W comes NW, then back to N.

text: Of Africa, Asia, Europe, Antarctica and South America, how many begin and end with the same letter?
why: AfricA, AsiA, EuropE and AntarcticA all do, but South America starts with S and ends with A.

text: Which country is hidden in this sentence: 'The dragon breathed fire landing on the castle'?
why: Read across the words: 'fire landing' hides I-R-E-L-A-N-D.

text: A plane leaves London and flies 1,000 miles due north, then 1,000 due east, then 1,000 due south, then 1,000 due west. Does it land east of London, west of London, or back at London?
why: The 1,000 miles east is further north, where longitude lines are closer together, so it covers more longitude than the 1,000 miles west.
